observation.coherence: one retail-main-thread callback; identical Game pointer/frame, Objects pointer/array metadata, Leader flags, and encrypted-economy pointer before and after

identity.local_slot: exactly one Leader slot whose flags & 7 equals 7

economy.commerce_cap_x16_i32: first six resource_cap entries, XOR 0x1281; income clamp in x16 units, not stored-resource capacity

required_gates: type pointer and TypeIndex are readable
objects.unit_order: canonical OrderList head->prev->data; empty head never uses stale current_data cache
objects.angles: u32 binary angle modulo 2^32; 0 is north/-y

excluded: all enemy and neutral owner lists
enemy economy, orders, targets, and target coordinates
fog-hidden map, goods, rare resources, items, ammo, and death arrays
Object.visible and WData.was_seen until per-local-slot LOS semantics are proven

action_batch.supervision: the observed match must begin paused; every live run restores pause and STOP-parks the hook

move.object_ids: exactly one active unit from the same observation
move.target: x/y must lie within observed public world bounds

action_batch.retail_ingress: shipped CommandManager issue method on the retail main thread; no raw CommandPackage writes
